metric.sharedFirstLoadKb: polyfillFiles + rootMainFiles from .next/build-manifest.json: the chunk set every route references
metric.routes: every client <script src> in the HTML the built server returns for the route; [param] segments use a probe value

rebaselineNote: Next.js 16 stopped printing the Size and First Load JS columns, so the previous numbers (shared 112, routes 213-242) could no longer be measured by any available source and every route was silently skipped. Budgets are re-measured against the served route HTML with the same 5% regression headroom as before.
